item.title: Strikes may set Iran back — but likely won't end nuclear program, UN watchdog chief warns
item.summary: U.N. nuclear chief says Iran's nuclear program cannot be eliminated by airstrikes alone, with uranium stockpiles and underground facilities remaining intact.

item.title: Russia ships fuel to Cuba using 'spoofing' tactic challenging Trump embargo: reports
item.summary: Hong Kong-flagged tanker allegedly delivered 190,000 barrels of Russian oil to Cuba using AIS spoofing and ship-to-ship transfers to evade U.S. sanctions.

item.title: GOP governors, AGs back Trump SAVE Act push, warn system gives ‘undue influence’ to states with illegal aliens
item.summary: Republican governors and attorneys general back citizenship verification through the SAVE America Act for federal elections, arguing gaps in voter registration create unfair influence.

item.title: Restaurant owner could 'go broke' under blue state's proposed to-go packaging ban, he warns
item.summary: Connecticut lawmakers consider banning polystyrene takeout packaging by 2028, joining California and New York in restricting Styrofoam containers.

item.title: One dead after cable car detaches, plummets at Swiss ski resort
item.summary: A 61-year-old woman died Wednesday after a gondola detached and crashed on a snowy mountainside in Engelberg, Switzerland, authorities said.

item.title: 'Bachelorette' star Taylor Frankie Paul says domestic violence allegations feel 'like the end of the world'
item.summary: "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" star Taylor Frankie Paul opens up about "heavy" domestic violence accusations, prioritizing her children amid the intense public scrutiny.

item.title: Venezuela's Delcy Rodriguez replaces sanctioned loyalist defense minister with military intel head
item.summary: Acting president Delcy Rodriguez has appointed Gustavo Gonzalez Lopez to lead the defense ministry, a move to consolidate military control.

item.title: White House says ‘no one’ changing Trump enforcement agenda in response to Angel Mom appeal to Mullin
item.summary: The White House and DHS issued a response to a request by Angel Mom Angie Morfin, whose 13-year-old son, Ruben, was executed by an illegal alien gang member in California.

item.title: Oscars 2026 viewership drops 9% on ABC, Hulu, marking first decline since 2021
item.summary: Viewership for the 98th Academy Awards on ABC and Hulu dropped 9% to 17.9 million viewers in the first major decline since 2021, according to Nielsen data.

item.title: ‘How do you sleep at night?' Moreno slams ‘disgraceful’ shutdown leaving 260,000 workers without pay
item.summary: Sen. Bernie Moreno slams Democrats as 'disgusting' over government shutdown blame, highlighting 260,000 DHS employees working without paychecks during crisis.
